title: Claude Haiku 5.5 / high effort
description: A white pelican with a yellow beak, dark wing tips, and orange legs riding a red bicycle with dark tires and dense silver spokes; the opening framing crops the top of the head, and the pink throat pouch floats detached below the beak.

This CLI version also injects an environment block (cwd, OS, git status) and the account email, which cannot be disabled (~674-token bare context probe vs 253 on 2.1.214).

unmetRequirements.evidence: The initial 960x540 view cuts off the top of the head and eye and clips the bottom of the front wheel. All eight level views (level-00 to level-07) crop the head at the top edge; the camera targets y 0.85 (line 235) with focal 1.8 (line 240) while the head reaches about y 1.84.

unmetRequirements.requirement: Throat pouch attached to the beak
unmetRequirements.evidence: The pouch ellipsoid at (0.5, 1.42) with y-radius 0.11 (line 119) tops out near y 1.53, while the lower mandible (line 118) bottoms out near y 1.57 at the same x, and nothing joins them. The pouch hangs as a separate floating ellipsoid with visible background between it and the beak in initial, level-00, level-04 and raised-01.

close-00 to close-02 frame the torso, legs and handlebar; the beak is out of frame in all three and only the bottom edge of the pouch is visible. The close-range camera target stays at (0.3, 1.12, 0) (lines 236 and 305-306), below the beak at y 1.56-1.72.

warnings: Concentric ripple artifacts appear on the ground near the rear wheel in initial, level-00, raised-00 and close-00.
